ticker_news.title: Prediction: 2 AI Stocks Will Be Worth More Than Apple Stock by the Year's End in 2025
ticker_news.description: Nvidia and Microsoft are predicted to surpass Apple's current market value of $3.6 trillion by the end of 2025, driven by their dominance in the AI market. Nvidia's AI accelerator sales and Microsoft's AI-powered enterprise software are expected to drive their growth.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: The Smartest Vanguard ETF to Buy With $500 Right Now
ticker_news.description: The article discusses the Vanguard S&P 500 Value ETF (VOOV) as a complement to the standard S&P 500 or growth-focused portfolios. It highlights the ETF's value-focused approach and more balanced sector exposure compared to the broader S&P 500.
ticker_news.author: Stefon Walters
